newsitem.title: USA: DOMINION'S VA. POWER APPROVED FOR TELECOM.
newsitem.headline: DOMINION'S VA. POWER APPROVED FOR TELECOM.

text.p: Virginia Power, a unit of Dominion Resources Inc, said on Tuesday the State Corporation Commission has approved a Virginia Power entrance into the telecommunications market.
The commission on allowed VPS Communications Inc, a Virginia Power subsidiary, to offer limited inter-exchange telecommunications services throughout Virginia, the company said in a statement.
VPS Communications will be a competitive access provider, linking long-distance carriers directly with larger customers such as businesses and government agencies, the company said.
The subsidiary will also offer direct, non-switched, dedicated telecommunications links between large customers' facilities located in different local exchanges.
Also, VPS Communications will offer wholesale service to telecommunications providers through leased capacity on Virginia Power's 270-mile fiber-optic network.
The company's wholesale services business, which will start in September, will be the initial focus in telecommunications, the company said.
